name: ResetDateTime
author: Clinton Hall
about: Sets the modified date of downloaded files to now, so new downloads sort as new.
requirements: This extension requires Python 3.8 or newer.
description: Files inside a download keep the dates they were packed with, which
can be months or years ago. Media players that sort by "recently
added" then bury your new downloads.
ResetDateTime sets the modified date of every downloaded file to now.
Move it to the top of the Extension Manager's Order list, so it runs
before anything that moves or imports the files.
